inputs.name: Finite cyclotomic Galois theory and original-closure extension
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Section 6, basic cyclotomic results (especially Proposition 6.2); finite Galois extension of embeddings
inputs.accepted_statement: The finite cyclotomic action identifies Gal(Q(mu_M)/Q) with (Z/M)^× and finite automorphisms extend to the specified algebraic closure.
inputs.exact_specialization: AX1 and AX3--AX4 evaluate every component using one cyclotomic residue in the original Omega. Total ramification of l-power roots is derived by the Eisenstein polynomial Phi_(l^r)(1+X); unramifiedness and the arithmetic Frobenius power are derived by Hensel lifting.

inputs.name: Finite local-field ramification and decomposition groups
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Theorem 7.50 and Corollaries 7.51--7.52; Proposition 7.55; Theorem 7.58 and Corollary 7.59; Proposition 8.10 and the decomposition/inertia discussion of Section 8
inputs.accepted_statement: Finite residue extensions lift uniquely to finite unramified local extensions; wild inertia is pro-p and the prime-to-p tame quotient has its root-of-uniformizer description; chosen global decomposition/inertia groups identify with their local-completion counterparts.
inputs.exact_specialization: AX3 uses compact nested fibers to obtain the full inertia cyclotomic map and changes Frobenius only by inertia. AX6 derives the p−1 bound for the finite abelian inertia image from Frob*tau*Frob^-1=tau^p, avoiding a blanket Kronecker--Weber or local-CFT predicate. All original places and conjugations are preserved.

inputs.name: Unique valuation on finite extensions of a complete discretely valued field
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Theorem 7.38 (same finite-local-field fact used by RV1)
inputs.accepted_statement: A finite extension of a complete discretely valued characteristic-zero field is complete and has the unique extended absolute value.
inputs.exact_specialization: AX8 derives boundedness and strict maximal-ideal bounds for every actual algebra map to Qbar_l from the norms of all conjugates and the unit criterion. It then proves a uniform m^n bound and actual entry continuity. No common finite-field assertion for arbitrary compact subsets is used.

inputs.name: Finite algebras over Henselian local rings and completeness
inputs.author: The Stacks Project
inputs.accepted_statement: Complete local rings are Henselian. A finite algebra over a Henselian local ring is a finite product of local rings, each finite and local over the base.
inputs.exact_specialization: For the actual domain B and an integral v=t/d, B[v] is a finite domain and hence one local factor. The original diagonal point maps v to zero, forcing v into that maximal ideal; every other original algebraic specialization then has norm<1. The divided eigenvalue and every transfer are proved explicitly.

previously_reconstructed_inputs.used_scope: Literal CorX with both original and inverse residual characters, arbitrary residue field and prime-to-l relative-index UnrEv. AX4 proves the actual local T/K transfer.
Exact coefficient extension and normalized length cancellation under the finite DVR enlargement allowed in SP8.
Injective coefficient invariants and normalized return to the original coefficient; no model or automorphy predicate is inferred.
